description: This file is a PHP source file that generates a web page for configuring Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) on a wireless network device. It includes server-side PHP code for retrieving and setting WPS configuration parameters, as well as client-side JavaScript for user interaction and AJAX communication with backend scripts.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a WPS PIN entered by the user.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to set WPS configuration parameters on the device.
